extractedText: Mark is the head of the Hedge Fund Group. In his role, he is responsible for the overall strategy for the group, with a key focus on investment results, attracting and retaining talent, and growing the business. As part of his responsibilities, he is the team leader and portfolio manager for the Global Macro Team. As a portfolio manager, he focuses on manager selection and allocation, risk management across the team’s multi-strategy investment process, and strategic planning. He is responsible for the aggregate risk and investment results for the team.
